tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.summary_outcome: Resolved. The stockout was a cash problem: CC-TEE-WHITE size S was at 0 on hand, and the rush reprint that would refill it sat behind invoice 501, unpaid and 3 days past the desk date. Inventory identified the blocker, handed it to Accounting, who drafted a voucher and stopped. A human approved the $840.00 to Bulldog Print Co, the invoice flipped to paid, and the reprint was released. Customer Service quoted 2026-09-05, the vendor 5-day lead time measured from the desk date, rather than a date that outran the payment.
tickets.no_ship_with_unpaid_invoice: Enforced. No delivery date was promised to Tauhid Zaman until invoice 501 was settled.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.summary_outcome: Resolved as a quote. Size M held 8 units against the 20 requested, a shortfall of 12 that is invisible to anyone reading the SKU total of 32 across all sizes. Inventory put the missing 12 on a Bulldog Print Co reprint at 5 lead days (about 2026-09-05). Accounting bounded the discount at 62.1% off list, the point at which the $58.00 list price reaches the $22.00 unit cost. Customer Service drafted a quote of 8 now and 12 to follow, with the discount proposed rather than granted. No cash moved.
tickets.no_ship_with_unpaid_invoice: Enforced in spirit - nothing was promised beyond what stock and lead times support.

agent_contributions.contribution: Set the floor at $22.00 per unit and capped any discount at 62.1% off list, escalating the override to a human.
Routed to Customer Service because the deliverable was a quote, not a database change.
Read stock by size rather than the SKU total, caught the 12-unit shortfall, and drafted the quote.
Supplied the per-size spread (S 4, M 8, L 14, XL 6) and the 5-day reprint lead time for the missing 12.
